name: pushie
description: Meet pushie, the virtual pet living in your repositories. Keep him alive by pushing code, watch him evolve with your PRs, and get roasted by his AI for messy commit messages.

pushie.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API Key to let pushie roast your code. You can also use keys from free providers like Groq or OpenRouter if you change the Base URL.

pushie.apiBaseUrl.description: The API endpoint for OpenAI-compatible services. Change this to use free APIs like Groq (https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions) or local LM Studio (http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions).

pushie.apiModel.description: The model to use. E.g., 'gpt-4o-mini' for OpenAI, 'llama3-8b-8192' for Groq, or 'local-model' for LM Studio.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
